one_liner: Marketing, sales, and customer-service CRM platform with a broad REST API.

auth.evidence_quote: There are two ways to authenticate calls to HubSpot's APIs: OAuth, and private app access tokens.
auth.notes: Private app access tokens are single-portal fixed tokens (bearer_token, not called an 'API key' by HubSpot -- HubSpot retired classic API keys in 2022). OAuth is required for apps that connect to multiple/other customers' HubSpot accounts.

access.evidence_quote: OAuth credentials are then used to connect to the mcp.hubspot.com endpoint through any compatible MCP client.
access.notes: HubSpot offers free developer test accounts (self-serve). Public OAuth apps intended for the App Marketplace / arbitrary third-party portals go through HubSpot's app review/certification process; internal-only private apps have no such gate (extra_gate reflects the third-party OAuth app path).

api.evidence_quote: HubSpot MCP server supports OAuth 2.0. Later in 2025, we will align with MCP specification requirements for OAuth 2.1 support.
api.notes: Official remote MCP server at mcp.hubspot.com reached general availability with read/write access per WebSearch summary; OAuth-based.

verdict.rationale: Free developer accounts, OAuth2 support for third-party integrations, a broad REST API, and an official OAuth-based MCP server.
